caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate sofa placed centrally within a rectangular frame sketched on a plain background. The sofa features intricate, curved wooden arms and legs, with the wood shown in a brown hue and highlighted by carved detailing, particularly on the front legs and the framework. The cushioned seating area, backrest, and inner sides are upholstered in a deep blue color, accented by gold or yellow-green trim that outlines the contours of the sofa. The backrest is high and rolled, transitioning seamlessly into the scrolling arms on each side. The base of the sofa, just above the legs, also features carved wooden detailing. There is subtle shading on the surface beneath the sofa in light blue and graphite tones, suggesting the floor or ground. The overall composition is balanced within the hand-drawn rectangular boundary, with the sofa as the sole object in the drawing.
title: Sofa
